sections.text:
-Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies 2 times with magic dark damage at success of 100 points.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases all stats of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Casts a ward on all allies.
-Removes debuffs from all allies.
